data.desc: Everspin Technologies, Inc. is the world's leading provider of Magnetoresistive RAM (MRAM). Everspin MRAM delivers the industry's most robust, highest-performance non-volatile memory for industrial, data center, automotive, aerospace and other mission-critical applications where data persistence is essential. Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona , Everspin provides commercially available MRAM solutions to a large and diverse customer base.
